long_biography.plain_text:
Boillon began training as a pastry chef while still a teenager, later studying at the Lenôtre school in Paris and working in Europe and the Caribbean. He moved to Australia and founded Laurent Bakery in 1993 with one South Yarra café. French technique and an emphasis on sourdough distinguished the business, which grew from neighbourhood retail into a scaled bakery and wholesale supplier.

A national supply partnership with Coles carried Laurent-branded bread into supermarkets, while the group built eighteen stores and two production facilities. BGH Capital took a controlling stake in 2021, with Boillon remaining involved, and Bridor acquired Laurent Bakery four years later. He continues to oversee its operations, but the stores, factories and wholesale contracts belong to the company rather than to him personally.

The Sanlorenzo Alloy yacht "Aix," measuring 44 feet, was completed and delivered in July 2022. The construction of the yacht began based on speculation and it was subsequently sold in July 2021. The buyer was represented by Brock Rodwell from Ray White Marine and EKKA Yachts. At the time of the sale, the initial price of the yacht was set at €25,500,000.

The yacht's classification society, ABS, has recorded its registration under the ownership of the Australian company Juleboat Pty Ltd. The Australian Securities & Investments Commission (ASIC) confirms that the single shareholder of Juleboat Pty Ltd is Laurent Boillon. Boillon, originally from France and residing in Australia for a significant period, is associated with the ownership.

Laurent Boillon is the proprietor of Laurent Bakery Group, which manages nearly 20 bakeries across Melbourne. Renowned for its French-inspired pastries, cakes, and bread, the bakery group also functions as a supplier to the widely recognized national supermarket chain, Coles.

In the year 2021, the Australian private equity firm BGH Capital made an investment in the Laurent Bakery Group. While the exact investment sum remains undisclosed, BGH Capital is noted for its equity investments spanning from AUD100 million to 500 million.
